sections.title: Page 1

summary.text: The first page of World Health Assembly resolution WHA71.7 on digital health (26 May 2018), which recalls earlier eHealth resolutions and recognizes the potential of digital technologies to support health systems and the Sustainable Development Goals. Its preamble stresses that digital solutions should complement existing services, that human interaction remains vital, and that technology transfer and cooperation matter.

sections.extract: SEVENTY-FIRST WORLD HEALTH ASSEMBLY WHA71.7 Agenda item 12.4 26 May 2018 Digital health The Seventy-first World Health Assembly, Having considered the report on mHealth;1 Recalling resolutions WHA58.28 (2005) on eHealth and WHA66.24 (2013) on eHealth standardization and interoperability; Recognizing the potential of digital technologies to advance the Sustainable Development Goals, and in particular to support

sections.title: Page 2

summary.text: Sets out what the resolution urges Member States to do, such as assess their use of digital technologies, integrate them into health systems and regulation, and build workforce digital skills. It also calls for public trust in digital health through work with civil society.

sections.extract: WHA71.7 2 1. URGES Member States:1 (1) to assess their use of digital technologies for health, including in health information systems at the national and subnational levels, in order to identify areas of improvement, and to prioritize, as appropriate, the development, evaluation, implementation, scale-up and greater utilization of digital technologies, as a means of promoting equitable, affordable and universal

sections.title: Page 3

summary.text: Continues the requests to Member States, including data protection legislation and partnerships across sectors. It then lists requests to the Director-General, starting with developing a global strategy on digital health and including guidance, a repository of evidence and collaboration with other UN bodies.

sections.title: Page 4

summary.text: The final page of resolution WHA71.7, asking for a progress report to the Seventy-third World Health Assembly in 2020.

sections.extract: WHA71.7 4 (8) to submit a report to the Seventy-third World Health Assembly in 2020 on the progress made in implementing this resolution. Seventh plenary meeting, 26 May 2018 A71/VR/7 = = =
